advancement.anima.root.title: Anima
advancement.anima.root.description: Follow The Necronomicon from a stolen soul to magic, living machines and gods.
advancement.anima.codex.title: A Guide to Anima
advancement.anima.codex.description: Obtain The Necronomicon. Craft it with a book and a bone.
advancement.anima.soulbone.title: The First Soulbone
advancement.anima.soulbone.description: Obtain soulbone by killing a living creature while holding a bone.
advancement.anima.blue_crystal.title: Crystal Seed
advancement.anima.blue_crystal.descripti: Obtain blue crystal from a cluster. Start one with soulbone and lapis in water over stone.
advancement.anima.yellow_crystal.title: A Rare Growth
advancement.anima.yellow_crystal.descrip: Obtain yellow crystal from a mature yellow cluster.
advancement.anima.crystal_armor.title: Crystal Shell
advancement.anima.crystal_armor.descript: Collect all four pieces of Crystal Armor.
advancement.anima.molten.title: Into the Lava
advancement.anima.molten.description: Collect a bucket of molten glass, blue crystal or yellow crystal.
advancement.anima.glassworking.title: Shape with Air
advancement.anima.glassworking.descripti: Obtain a Blow Mold and Bellows for glassworking.
advancement.anima.glassware.title: Complete Glassworks
advancement.anima.glassware.description: Collect a Funnel, Decanter, Splitter, Gourd and Spiral.
advancement.anima.blue_gem.title: Blue Gem
advancement.anima.blue_gem.description: Obtain a Blue Gem from molten blue crystal and a Gem Mold.
advancement.anima.yellow_gem.title: Yellow Gem
advancement.anima.yellow_gem.description: Obtain a Yellow Gem from molten yellow crystal and a Gem Mold.
advancement.anima.stamper.title: Under Pressure
advancement.anima.stamper.description: Obtain a Circuit Stamper. A redstone pulse stamps its four inputs.
advancement.anima.splinters.title: Split the Bone
advancement.anima.splinters.description: Obtain Soulbone Splinters from the Circuit Stamper.
advancement.anima.conduit.title: A Path for Souls
advancement.anima.conduit.description: Obtain Soulbone Conduits from splinters and redstone.
advancement.anima.circuit.title: Control Circuit
advancement.anima.circuit.description: Obtain a Control Circuit from a Blue Gem and three conduits.
advancement.anima.spear.title: Bone Collector
advancement.anima.spear.description: Obtain a Soulbone Spear to turn bone drops into soulbone.
advancement.anima.components.title: Precision Parts
advancement.anima.components.description: Collect an Emitter, Ponderance Lattice and Quantifier.
advancement.anima.detector.title: Find a Village
advancement.anima.detector.description: Obtain a Village Detector. Use it to check the nearest village's distance.
advancement.anima.soul_gem.title: Souls to Go
advancement.anima.soul_gem.description: Obtain a Soul Gem to carry bottled souls and pay spell costs.
advancement.anima.golem_assembler.title: A Body in Pieces
advancement.anima.golem_assembler.descri: Obtain a Golem Part Assembler to build a permanent body you can pilot.
advancement.anima.golem_fabricator.title: The Waiting Body
advancement.anima.golem_fabricator.descr: Obtain a Golem Fabricator. Fit a head, torso, two arms and two legs.
advancement.anima.pilot_golem.title: Iron Hands, Living Soul
advancement.anima.pilot_golem.descriptio: Pilot your own Workshop Golem using a Soul Leash or Incorporeal.
advancement.anima.cage.title: Containment
advancement.anima.cage.description: Obtain a Bone Cage to hold creatures for extraction.
advancement.anima.capture.title: Behind Bone Bars
advancement.anima.capture.description: Let a Bone Cage you own capture a creature.
advancement.anima.extraction.title: Separate the Soul
advancement.anima.extraction.description: Complete a correct four-piece glassware extraction from a cage you own.
advancement.anima.first_soul.title: Bottled Soul
advancement.anima.first_soul.description: Obtain any bottled soul. Catch a released spirit with a glass bottle.
advancement.anima.all_souls.title: Nine Kinds
advancement.anima.all_souls.description: Collect all nine kinds of bottled soul, including God Souls.
advancement.anima.well.title: A Well of Souls
advancement.anima.well.description: Complete a twelve-stone Soul Well ring, or deposit a soul into a working well.
advancement.anima.bank.title: A Varied Reserve
advancement.anima.bank.description: Deposit each of the eight soul kinds into a Soul Well over time.
advancement.anima.relay.title: Soul Routes
advancement.anima.relay.description: Obtain a Soul Relay to guide loose souls toward a well.
advancement.anima.focus.title: A Focus for Magic
advancement.anima.focus.description: Obtain a Foci from the Circuit Stamper.
advancement.anima.cast.title: First Spell
advancement.anima.cast.description: Successfully cast any spell with a Foci.
advancement.anima.research_table.title: Research Table
advancement.anima.research_table.descrip: Obtain a Research Table to write and translate spell books.
advancement.anima.spell_book.title: Unfamiliar Script
advancement.anima.spell_book.description: Obtain a spell book from loot or a Research Table.
advancement.anima.scribe.title: Put It on Paper
advancement.anima.scribe.description: Have a Research Table you own successfully write an encrypted spell book.
advancement.anima.translate.title: Deciphered
advancement.anima.translate.description: Have a Research Table you own successfully translate a spell book.
advancement.anima.learn.title: New Knowledge
advancement.anima.learn.description: Learn a non-starter spell from a translated spell book.
advancement.anima.all_spells.title: Complete Spellbook
advancement.anima.all_spells.description: Learn every spell that is not known from the start.
advancement.anima.flight.title: Take Flight
advancement.anima.summon.title: Animated Ally
advancement.anima.summon.description: Successfully cast Animate Golem or Animate Spider.
advancement.anima.projection.title: Outside Your Body
advancement.anima.projection.description: Leave your body using a Mirror or Incorporeal. Shelter the body you leave behind.
advancement.anima.possession.title: Another Point of View
advancement.anima.possession.description: Possess a creature using a Soul Leash or Incorporeal.
advancement.anima.all_casts.title: Practice Every Spell
advancement.anima.all_casts.description: Successfully cast every spell with a Foci at least once.
advancement.anima.infusion_table.title: An Infusion Circle
advancement.anima.infusion_table.descrip: Obtain an Infusion Table. Place eight plinths around it, all on Soul Stone.
advancement.anima.infusion.title: Offer and Transform
advancement.anima.infusion.description: Start an infusion and let the complete ritual finish.
advancement.anima.soulbone_armor.title: Soulbone Suit
advancement.anima.soulbone_armor.descrip: Collect all four pieces of Soulbone Armor.
advancement.anima.raw_saronite.title: A New Metal
advancement.anima.raw_saronite.descripti: Obtain Raw Saronite through infusion with a Doomed soul.
advancement.anima.forge.title: Soul-Fired Forge
advancement.anima.forge.description: Obtain a Soul Forge and supply it with worker souls from a nearby well.
advancement.anima.saronite.title: Refined Saronite
advancement.anima.saronite.description: Obtain a Saronite Ingot from a Soul Forge.
advancement.anima.saronite_tools.title: Saronite Toolkit
advancement.anima.saronite_tools.descrip: Collect a Saronite Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
advancement.anima.reap.title: Release on Impact
advancement.anima.reap.description: Release a creature's soul with a killing blow from your Saronite Sword or Saronite Arrow.
advancement.anima.saronite_armor.title: Saronite Suit
advancement.anima.saronite_armor.descrip: Collect all four pieces of Saronite Armor.
advancement.anima.god_soul.title: A Spark of Divinity
advancement.anima.god_soul.description: Obtain a God Soul. Harvest one with a Saronite Sword's final blow and a carried glass bottle.
advancement.anima.ring_of_power.title: Lord of the Skies
advancement.anima.ring_of_power.descript: Obtain a Ring of Power, or complete its infusion with five God Souls.
advancement.anima.all_infusions.title: Master of Infusion
advancement.anima.all_infusions.descript: Start and complete every infusion recipe at least once.
advancement.anima.deity_fabricator.title: Give Divinity a Name
advancement.anima.deity_fabricator.descr: Obtain a Deity Fabricator. Prepare a God Soul and a unique three-item code.
advancement.anima.create_deity.title: Let There Be a God
advancement.anima.create_deity.descripti: Complete a Deity Fabricator ritual and bring your named god into the Pantheon.
advancement.anima.pantheon.title: Names in the Heavens
advancement.anima.pantheon.description: Consult a Pantheon to discover gods, their codes, sacred items and standing.
advancement.anima.dedicate_shrine.title: A Place of Faith
advancement.anima.dedicate_shrine.descri: Dedicate a shrine using three Offering Plates and a god's code. The god may be yours or another player's.
advancement.anima.worship.title: An Answered Offering
advancement.anima.worship.description: Offer a god's sacred item at its shrine and earn worship.
advancement.anima.devout.title: An Unbroken Vow
advancement.anima.devout.description: Become devout by worshipping the same god five times in a row.
advancement.anima.priest.title: Voice of the Divine
advancement.anima.priest.description: While devout, bind a Priest Rod at your god's shrine.
advancement.anima.blessing.title: A Hand of Grace
advancement.anima.blessing.description: Successfully use your Priest Rod's Blessing. Select with left-click, then cast with right-click.
advancement.anima.curse.title: A Word of Judgment
advancement.anima.curse.description: Successfully use your Priest Rod's Curse on a non-devout target.
advancement.anima.divine_power.title: Heaven Answers
advancement.anima.divine_power.descripti: Invoke your god's Power while it leads the Pantheon, including a tie.
advancement.anima.shrine_travel.title: Paths of the Faithful
advancement.anima.shrine_travel.descript: Spend worship to travel between two shrines of the same god.
advancement.anima.deity_hammer.title: Knock on Heaven's Door
advancement.anima.deity_hammer.descripti: Obtain a Deity Hammer. Prepare an open arena and three plates holding a god's code.
advancement.anima.summon_avatar.title: The Heavens Descend
advancement.anima.summon_avatar.descript: Activate a Deity Hammer and complete the avatar's descent. Be ready for an endgame battle.
advancement.anima.defeat_avatar.title: Even Gods Can Fall
advancement.anima.defeat_avatar.descript: Defeat an avatar as its challenger or an active nearby fighter. Its god is permanently removed from the Pantheon.
advancement.anima.automation.title: Souls at Work
advancement.anima.automation.description: Let any automation machine you own complete a job.
advancement.anima.soul_placer.title: Place It
advancement.anima.soul_placer.descriptio: Let a machine of this type that you own place a block.
advancement.anima.soul_breaker.title: Break It
advancement.anima.soul_breaker.descripti: Let a machine of this type that you own break a block.
advancement.anima.totem_of_harvesting.de: Let a machine of this type that you own harvest and replant a mature crop.
advancement.anima.totem_of_gathering.des: Let a machine of this type that you own collect a dropped item.
advancement.anima.totem_of_shepherding.d: Let a machine of this type that you own shear a sheep.
advancement.anima.totem_of_breeding.desc: Let a machine of this type that you own feed a pair of animals for breeding.
advancement.anima.totem_of_forestry.desc: Let a machine of this type that you own fell a tree and replant a sapling.
advancement.anima.all_automation.title: A Working Workshop
advancement.anima.all_automation.descrip: Let each of the seven automation machines you own complete a job.
advancement.anima.robe.title: Ceremonial Attire
advancement.anima.robe.description: Obtain a Ceremonial Robe for offerings at the Altar of Souls.
advancement.anima.altar.title: Altar of Souls
advancement.anima.altar.description: Obtain an Altar of Souls. Wear your robe and bring four souls and a matching offering.
advancement.anima.offering.title: An Accepted Offering
advancement.anima.offering.description: Complete an offering at the Altar of Souls and receive an enchanted book.
advancement.anima.all_offerings.title: Every Offering
advancement.anima.all_offerings.descript: Complete an offering with each of the eight soul kinds.
advancement.anima.reconstructor.title: Rebuild the Body
advancement.anima.reconstructor.descript: Obtain a Corporeal Reconstructor. Build its ring and cage near a well with a Wise soul.
advancement.anima.reconstruction.title: Life Restored
advancement.anima.reconstruction.descrip: Rebuild an undead captive in a Corporeal Reconstructor using a cage you own.
